READING THE RECORD

Energy over time.
Power at a moment.

kWh measures energy over a period. The daily total and approximate hour intervals describe recorded generation. kW measures power at a moment. They answer different questions.

Generation records help an operator see patterns and investigate changes. On their own they do not establish consumption on site, imports, exports, savings or the reason for a change. Compare them with demand records, conditions and the system’s specification.
